scenes.say: Five IndyCar titles, and he is only twenty-nine. Alex Palou is champion again.
It was settled on the thirtieth of August at Milwaukee, one race before the season finale.
Fourth title in a row. Sebastien Bourdais won four straight in Champ Car, two thousand four to seven.
He is now third on the all-time list. Only A.J. Foyt and Scott Dixon have more titles.
This season Palou has six wins and eight poles, more than anyone else.
Japanese Super Formula in twenty nineteen, IndyCar with Dale Coyne in twenty twenty, Ganassi title in twenty twenty-one.
And in twenty twenty-five he won the Indianapolis five hundred, the first Spaniard to do it.

title: Palou wins a fifth IndyCar title: the story behind it
